# Niloy Biswas

> Niloy Biswas is an AI/LLM engineer and data analyst at 10 Minute School in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He works on TenTen, 10MS's AI study partner (RAG, intent routing, product analytics), and on BigQuery and Looker Studio data systems. His machine-learning research is published in Hindawi's BioMed Research International.

Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Open to remote roles and projects. Site: https://niloy.tech

## About

- Positioning: AI/LLM Engineer & Data Analyst
- 4+ years working in data
- Stack: Python, SQL, BigQuery, Looker Studio, LangGraph, RAG, vector search

## Case studies

- [TenTen - AI Study Partner](https://niloy.tech/projects/tenten/): TenTen, 10 Minute School's AI study partner for Bangladesh: RAG over curriculum content, intent routing, and post-launch product analytics.
- [USAID HSEP: Teacher Training Analytics](https://niloy.tech/projects/hsep/): Learning analytics for USAID's HSEP teacher training pilot in Bangladesh: 479 teachers, BigQuery, Looker Studio, and the data trail of the 2025 aid freeze.
- [Chicago Taxi Trips](https://niloy.tech/projects/chicago-taxi/): Looker Studio and BigQuery dashboard for Chicago taxi trip data - demand, revenue, and route patterns at scale.
- [Heart Disease Prediction](https://niloy.tech/projects/heart-disease/): Machine learning comparison for heart disease prediction using clinical features - logistic regression, trees, SVM, and more.
- [BigQuery Cost Monitoring](https://niloy.tech/projects/bigquery-cost-monitoring/): Monitor BigQuery usage and costs on GCP with Looker Studio and the INFORMATION_SCHEMA JOBS table.
- [Population Density Map](https://niloy.tech/projects/population-density-maps/): 3D population density maps with R and Rayshader - Bangladesh, South Asia, and regional demographic storytelling.
- [CRM Sales Performance Dashboard](https://niloy.tech/projects/crm-sales/): CRM sales performance Looker Studio dashboard - pipeline health, win rates, and manager-level insights.
- [Air Quality of Dhaka](https://niloy.tech/projects/air-quality/): Dhaka air quality dashboard - AQI trends, seasonal patterns, and global pollution context with Looker Studio.
